rationale: A -14.4% gap with no identifiable catalyst, only ~3 minutes of price discovery, and a 64.8 bps spread offers no reliable directional edge — the early tape shows sellers absorbed and buyers reclaiming VWAP (a fade signal), while the daily structure is sharply lower (a continuation signal), leaving both directions roughly coin-flip. The round-trip cost of crossing this spread consumes most of any modest intraday edge available in a thin, unknown-float name on a risk-off tape. Standing aside until the spread tightens or one side definitively wins the VWAP battle is the highest-expectation action.
